paths.description: Crawler directives and accidental path disclosure

paths.title: Exposed Git repository metadata
paths.remediation: Block access to .git/ at the web server or reverse proxy, purge the directory from the deployed artifact, and rotate any secrets that were committed.

paths.title: Exposed Git configuration
paths.remediation: Block .git/ at the edge, redeploy a clean artifact, and review commit history for credentials.

paths.title: Exposed environment file
paths.remediation: Remove the file from the web root, block dotfiles, and rotate every credential it contained.

paths.title: Exposed local environment file
paths.remediation: Remove the file from the web root, block dotfiles, and rotate every credential it contained.

paths.title: Exposed production environment file
paths.remediation: Remove the file from the web root, block dotfiles, and rotate every credential it contained.

paths.title: Exposed macOS metadata file
paths.remediation: Remove .DS_Store files from deployment artifacts and block dotfiles at the edge.

paths.title: Apache server-status is exposed
paths.remediation: Restrict /server-status to localhost or remove mod_status from the public virtual host.

paths.title: phpinfo() output is exposed
paths.remediation: Delete phpinfo scripts from production and review the output for environment secrets.

paths.title: Spring Boot actuator environment is exposed
paths.remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints, disable /env, and rotate any exposed configuration values.

paths.title: Spring Boot actuator index is exposed
paths.remediation: Limit actuator exposure to the management network and require authentication.

paths.title: API documentation is publicly reachable
paths.remediation: Require authentication for API documentation or publish it only in non-production environments.

paths.title: OpenAPI description is publicly reachable
paths.remediation: Restrict API descriptions to trusted networks or require authentication.

paths.title: Swagger description is publicly reachable
paths.remediation: Restrict API descriptions to trusted networks or require authentication.

paths.title: Administrative interface is reachable
paths.remediation: Put administrative interfaces behind SSO, network allow-lists, and rate limiting; do not rely on an unguessable URL.

paths.title: Authentication portal is reachable
paths.remediation: Ensure the portal enforces MFA, rate limiting, and a patched authentication stack.

paths.title: Tomcat Manager is reachable
paths.remediation: Restrict /manager to trusted networks, remove default accounts, and require strong authentication.

paths.title: WordPress login is reachable
paths.remediation: Enforce MFA, rate limiting, and a Web Application Firewall rule for wp-login.php.

paths.title: Backup archive is publicly downloadable
paths.remediation: Remove backup archives from the web root, store them in encrypted object storage, and review access logs.

paths.title: Backup archive is publicly downloadable
paths.remediation: Remove backup archives from the web root, store them in encrypted object storage, and review access logs.

paths.title: Website archive is publicly downloadable
paths.remediation: Remove archives from the web root and audit the exposed content.

paths.title: Database dump is publicly downloadable
paths.remediation: Remove the dump, rotate database credentials, and review for regulated data exposure.

paths.title: Database dump is publicly downloadable
paths.remediation: Remove the dump, rotate database credentials, and review for regulated data exposure.

paths.title: Directory listing is enabled
paths.remediation: Disable auto-indexing and require authentication for file repositories.

paths.title: Directory listing is enabled
paths.remediation: Disable auto-indexing and require authentication for file repositories.

paths.title: Upload directory listing is enabled
paths.remediation: Disable auto-indexing and block execution of uploaded files.

paths.title: File directory listing is enabled
paths.remediation: Disable auto-indexing and require authorization for file downloads.

paths.title: Exposed Subversion metadata
paths.remediation: Block .svn/ at the edge and redeploy a clean artifact.

paths.title: Exposed Mercurial metadata
paths.remediation: Block .hg/ at the edge and redeploy a clean artifact.

paths.title: Container build file is exposed
paths.remediation: Exclude build files from deployment artifacts and block source extensions at the edge.

paths.title: Container composition file is exposed
paths.remediation: Remove deployment manifests from the web root and rotate any embedded credentials.

paths.title: Application package manifest is exposed
paths.remediation: Serve only built assets and block package manifests at the edge.

paths.title: Composer manifest is exposed
paths.remediation: Serve only public assets and block composer files at the edge.

paths.title: Metrics endpoint is publicly reachable
paths.remediation: Restrict metrics to the monitoring network and require authentication.

paths.title: Configuration document is publicly reachable
paths.remediation: Remove client configuration secrets and restrict server configuration documents.

paths.title: Legacy cross-domain policy is published
paths.remediation: Review the allow-list and remove the policy if Flash/Silverlight clients no longer exist.

paths.title: OpenID Connect configuration is published
paths.remediation: Review the advertised endpoints and ensure only intended flows are enabled.

paths.title: GraphQL endpoint is reachable
paths.remediation: Require authentication, disable introspection in production where appropriate, and enforce query limits.

paths.title: API root is reachable
paths.remediation: Require authentication and publish only intended API routes.

paths.title: Health endpoint is public
paths.remediation: Return minimal health data and restrict detailed diagnostics to the operational network.

paths.title: Health endpoint is public
paths.remediation: Return minimal health data and restrict detailed diagnostics to the operational network.
